def Extract(sublists):
    """Returns the first element of each sublist."""
    return [sublist[0] for sublist in sublists if len(sublist) > 0]

# Test cases
assert Extract([[1, 2], [3, 4, 5], [6, 7, 8, 9]]) == [1, 3, 6]
print("Test passed!")

# Additional edge case: empty sublists (handled safely)
assert Extract([[], [1], []]) == [1]

def Extract(sublists):
    """Returns the first element of each sublist."""
    return [sublist[0] for sublist in sublists if len(sublist) > 0]

# Test cases
assert Extract([[1, 2], [3, 4, 5], [6, 7, 8, 9]]) == [1, 3, 6]
print("Test passed!")

# Additional edge case: empty sublists (handled safely)
assert Extract([[], [1], []]) == [1]
